scoring_justification: Recompute equilibrium volume from raw ev_data.csv as the volume at minimum energy, compare to paper-reported volumes. summary.json values (ΔE, band gaps) are reference-matched to paper gold; trends and internal consistency are checked.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported equilibrium volumes, energy difference, and band gaps
hidden_assets.source_provenance: From the paper text: V0(PPV)=212.14 Å³, V0(PV)=214.75 Å³; ΔE=−0.191 eV; Eg(PPV)≈1.8 eV, Eg(PV)≈0.8 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published article.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numerical results of the paper's DFT calculations, verifiable in the manuscript.

outputs.description: Energy versus volume data for PPV and PV CaPtO3 calculated with DFT. The checker refits a second-order Birch-Murnaghan equation of state to verify the fitted equilibrium volume and bulk modulus, and checks relative trends.

items.equilibrium_volume_A3: float, equilibrium cell volume in Å³
items.equilibrium_energy_eV_per_fu: float, total energy per formula unit at equilibrium in eV
items.bulk_modulus_GPa: float, zero-pressure bulk modulus in GPa
items.band_gap_eV: float, fundamental band gap in eV

outputs.description: Compiled DFT results: equilibrium volumes, energies, bulk moduli, band gaps, and energy difference. The checker compares the agent-reported values to the paper's gold values with tolerances and verifies the required trends (V0 PPV < V0 PV, ΔE negative, B0 PPV > B0 PV, band gap PPV > PV).

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the paper's main stability, volume, bulk modulus, and band gap claims. The ASW/ECOV chemical bonding analysis is excluded, as it requires proprietary code and is not needed for the core quantitative claims. The checker fits the E(V) data to recompute V0 and B0, then compares the summary's reported numbers to hidden paper gold values with tolerances. The load-bearing E(V) scan step forces actual DFT calculations.

steps.description: Validate energy-volume scan: find minimum-energy volume and compare to paper V0; check number of points and presence of a physical minimum.
Check reported summary values against paper gold, trends, and internal consistency with ev_data.csv.
